title: An adaptive Galerkin neural-network method for minimum-norm control of wave equations
summary: We develop an adaptive Galerkin neural-network method for computing minimum-$L^2$-norm interior controls for wave equations with spatially varying coefficients. Within the Hilbert Uniqueness Method, adjoint waves are approximated directly in space-time by least-squares Galerkin projections onto trial spaces enriched by neural-network basis functions selected through residual-based training. Linear Galerkin solves determine the adjoint approximations, and a separate linear system reconstructs the control. The least-squares objective provides an indicator for adaptive enrichment and stopping;…
